description: Live snapshot of any address on Base: ETH balance, balances of major tokens (USDC, WETH, cbBTC, DAI, USDbC, cbETH, AERO, EURC) plus up to 20 extra token addresses you pass, the EVM account nonce, and whether the address is an EOA, a smart contract or an EIP-7702 delegated account. For EOAs the nonce reflects outgoing transactions only; this is not full transaction, token-transfer or trading history. Use to check a counterparty's holdings. Costs $0.005 in USDC on Base per successful call, paid with x402.

address.description: Wallet or contract address on Base (0x...)

tokens.description: Optional comma-separated extra ERC-20 addresses to check (max 20)

name: wallet
